scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/index.html dist/index.html && cp src/renderer.js dist/renderer.js && cp src/uiPreload.cjs dist/uiPreload.cjs && cp src/probePreload.cjs dist/probePreload.cjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.probe:runtime: npm run build && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/main.js --run-runtime-probe
